ARC-001-AWRS-v1.0.title: AWS Research and Architecture Recommendations: UK Government GenAI Playbook

controlFields.Distribution: Project Team, Architecture Team, CDDO, GDS, NCSC
controlFields.Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2: Relational data (if needed for governance tracking)
controlFields.Amazon SQS: Asynchronous message queuing for long-running tasks
controlFields.AWS Secrets Manager: $0.40 per secret per month, $0.05 per 10K API calls
controlFields.Amazon Bedrock Model Invocation Logs: Track Bedrock API calls, token usage, costs
controlFields.IAM.1: IAM policies should not allow full "*:*" administrative privileges
controlFields.Lambda.1: Lambda functions should prohibit public access
controlFields.S3.1: S3 Block Public Access setting should be enabled
controlFields.S3.4: S3 buckets should have server-side encryption enabled
controlFields.S3.8: S3 Block Public Access setting should be enabled at the bucket level
controlFields.CloudTrail.1: CloudTrail should be enabled and configured with at least one multi-region trail
controlFields.CloudTrail.2: CloudTrail should have encryption at rest enabled
controlFields.KMS.1: IAM customer managed policies should not allow decryption actions on all KMS keys
controlFields.SecretsManager.1: Secrets Manager secrets should have automatic rotation enabled
controlFields.APIGateway.1: API Gateway REST and WebSocket API execution logging should be enabled
controlFields.APIGateway.2: API Gateway REST API stages should be configured to use SSL certificates
controlFields.DynamoDB.1: DynamoDB tables should automatically scale capacity with demand
controlFields.DynamoDB.2: DynamoDB tables should have point-in-time recovery enabled
controlFields.APIGateway.3: API Gateway REST API stages should have AWS X-Ray tracing enabled
controlFields.APIGateway.4: API Gateway should be associated with a WAF Web ACL
controlFields.CloudTrail.4: CloudTrail log file validation should be enabled
controlFields.CloudTrail.5: CloudTrail trails should be integrated with CloudWatch Logs
controlFields.DynamoDB.3: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) clusters should be encrypted at rest
controlFields.IAM.3: IAM users' access keys should be rotated every 90 days or less
controlFields.IAM.4: IAM root user access key should not exist
controlFields.IAM.5: MFA should be enabled for all IAM users
controlFields.IAM.6: Hardware MFA should be enabled for the root user
controlFields.KMS.2: IAM principals should not have IAM inline policies that allow decryption actions on all KMS keys
controlFields.KMS.3: AWS KMS keys should not be unintentionally deleted
controlFields.KMS.4: AWS KMS key rotation should be enabled
controlFields.Lambda.2: Lambda functions should use supported runtimes
controlFields.Lambda.3: Lambda functions should be in a VPC
controlFields.Lambda.5: VPC Lambda functions should operate in multiple Availability Zones
controlFields.S3.2: S3 buckets should prohibit public read access
controlFields.S3.3: S3 buckets should prohibit public write access
controlFields.S3.5: S3 buckets should require requests to use SSL
controlFields.S3.6: S3 permissions granted to other AWS accounts in bucket policies should be restricted
controlFields.S3.9: S3 bucket server access logging should be enabled
controlFields.SecretsManager.2: Secrets Manager secrets configured with automatic rotation should rotate successfully
controlFields.SecretsManager.4: Secrets Manager secrets should be rotated within a specified number of days
controlFields.Data Minimisation (Article 5): Collect only necessary data (IAM user ID, department, usage metrics)
controlFields.Purpose Limitation: Data used only for playbook service delivery and analytics
controlFields.Encryption (Article 32): Encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
controlFields.Data Residency: All data processed and stored in eu-west-2 (UK)
controlFields.Data Retention: Automated deletion after defined periods (S3 Lifecycle, DynamoDB TTL)
controlFields.Data Subject Rights (Article 15-22): Support for access, deletion, portability via API
controlFields.Data Processing Agreement (DPA): AWS GDPR DPA accepted (via AWS Artifact)
controlFields.KMS: AWS Key Management Service - Encryption key management service
controlFields.AWS CDK: Imperative (TypeScript/Python), reusable constructs, type safety, generates CloudFormation
controlFields.AWS SAM: Serverless-focused, extension of CloudFormation, local testing
controlFields.ATRS: Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard - CDDO standard for disclosing algorithmic tools
controlFields.Bedrock: Amazon Bedrock - AWS managed service for foundation model inference
controlFields.CDK: AWS Cloud Development Kit - Infrastructure as Code framework using programming languages
controlFields.CMK: Customer-Managed Key - KMS encryption key owned and managed by the customer
controlFields.DPIA: Data Protection Impact Assessment - UK GDPR Article 35 requirement for high-risk processing
controlFields.FSBP: AWS Foundational Security Best Practices - Security Hub standard for AWS best practices
controlFields.G-Cloud: Government Cloud - UK procurement framework for cloud services
controlFields.Guardrails: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails - Content filtering and prompt injection protection service
controlFields.k-NN: k-Nearest Neighbors - Vector similarity search algorithm used in OpenSearch
controlFields.OCU: OpenSearch Compute Unit - Pricing unit for OpenSearch Serverless (4 OCU min for search)
controlFields.PITR: Point-in-Time Recovery - DynamoDB backup feature with 5-minute RPO
controlFields.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation - AI pattern grounding LLM outputs in external knowledge
controlFields.RTO: Recovery Time Objective - Maximum acceptable downtime (4 hours)
controlFields.RPO: Recovery Point Objective - Maximum acceptable data loss (1 hour)
controlFields.SLO: Service Level Objective - Target for service performance (e.g., 99.9% uptime)
controlFields.WAF: AWS Web Application Firewall - Layer 7 firewall for API Gateway and CloudFront

ARC-001-AZRS-v1.0.title: Azure Technology Research: UK Government GenAI Playbook

controlFields.Distribution: Project Team, Architecture Team, CDDO, GDS
controlFields.Data Protection (DP): DP-1, DP-2, DP-3, DP-4, DP-5, DP-6
controlFields.Prompt Engineering: Shorter system prompts, remove examples when not needed
controlFields.Model Selection: Use GPT-4o mini for simple tasks instead of GPT-4o
controlFields.UK Data Residency: Deploy all services to UK South (primary) and UK West (DR)
controlFields.No Data Export: Disable geo-replication outside UK, use private endpoints
controlFields.Encryption at Rest: TDE for SQL, SSE for Storage, customer-managed keys in Key Vault
controlFields.Encryption in Transit: TLS 1.2+ for all connections, private endpoints for internal traffic
controlFields.Audit Logging: 90-day retention in UK-based Log Analytics, 7-year archive to UK Storage
controlFields.5. Operational Security: Defender for Cloud, vulnerability scanning, patching
controlFields.9. Secure User Management: Entra ID, MFA, PIM, conditional access
controlFields.13. Audit Information for Users: Azure Monitor, Activity Log, diagnostic logs
